title: CROSS+WALKRI Round Configuration Schema (Funder Cohort)
description: The complete configuration a funder publishes for a round. Operationalizes the Commit stage of the CLEAR lifecycle. Supersedes v0.1.0 (skeleton); v0.2.0 fully populates fields for round-level primitives, gate configurations, population-anchored configurations, funder-side disciplines, evidence requirements, conflict and concurrent funding requirements, round operations, and Lens metadata. v0.2.1 renames the conformance_threshold field (formerly compliance_threshold) for Frame Language conformance; a breaking field rename.

obligation_mode.x-cross-walkri-source-section: CROSS Part III; Primitives Foundation v0.1.6 Layer 3
obligation_mode.description: The classification of what type of commitment this round creates: deliverable production (build), measured population change (change), or recognition of prior contribution (retroactive).

access_condition.description: Mechanism-specific terms that enable benefit to reach the stated population.

spdx_license.description: Required when mechanism_type is output_production. The SPDX identifier of the license under which outputs are released.

public_benefit_mechanism.x-cross-walkri-source-section: CROSS Part IVa; Primitives Foundation v0.1.6 Layer 3
public_benefit_mechanism.description: The mechanism by which the round produces public benefit. Each mechanism type constrains the minimum evidence scope required at completion.

restriction_predicate.description: Named classes of use that disqualify (e.g., military application, mass surveillance infrastructure, autonomous targeting).

verification_mechanism.description: How the applicant's intended use is checked against the restriction at the entry gate.

disclosure_obligation.description: What the applicant must declare about intended use in the application.

downstream_use_restriction.description: Optional. Funder-published restriction on intended use or downstream application of grant outputs, operationalized as an entry-gate eligibility filter.

development_stage_targeting.x-cross-walkri-source-section: CROSS Part II; Primitives Foundation v0.1.6 Layer 2
development_stage_targeting.description: Which development stages are within scope for this round. A round with no stage targeting accepts all five stages.

revenue_architecture_constraints.x-cross-walkri-source-section: CROSS Part II; Primitives Foundation v0.1.6 Layer 2
revenue_architecture_constraints.description: Which revenue architecture types are within scope for this round. Empty array means no constraint.

cohort_position.description: This round's relationship to prior rounds in the same program. Determines what prior work attribution is required.

coordination_scaling_standard_tier.description: The rigor tier the Coordination Scaling Standard calibrates this round at. Determined by funding amount and public impact claim scope.

denomination.description: Currency or token denomination (USD, EUR, OP, ETH, ARB, etc.).

budget.description: Total budget, allocation method, and disbursement schedule across gates.

pre_conditions_required.description: The five pre-conditions checked before any gate scoring begins.

criteria.description: Mode-specific criteria per CROSS Part III. Build mode: falsifiable deliverable with verifiable completion criteria. Change mode: FROM state as specific measurable condition. Retroactive mode: prior contribution evidence.

entry_specification_gate.description: The entry specification gate configuration. Operates as a binary pre-criterion before any rigor-tier scoring.

progress_verification_gates.description: Optional. Configured progress verification gates between entry and completion. Developmental in character; grantees retain iteration rights.

independent_verification_source.description: Named source from which verification can be obtained, lying outside the applicant's control per Commitment 6.

completion_verification_gate.x-cross-walkri-source-section: CROSS Part XI; Primitives Foundation v0.1.6 Layers 3 and 4
completion_verification_gate.description: The completion verification gate configuration. Summative in character; grantees have redress rights, not iteration rights.

continuation_specification_gate.x-cross-walkri-source-section: CROSS Part XII; Primitives Foundation v0.1.6 Layer 3
continuation_specification_gate.description: Optional. Configured at program level for multi-round programs.

pre_award_indicator_confirmation_stage.description: Optional but recommended. Substantive specification confirmation between entry-gate selection and disbursement start.

validating_parties.description: Named bodies or representatives drawn from or accountable to the affected population.

beneficiary_validation_mechanism.description: Required when public_benefit_mechanism.mechanism_type is condition_change or access_provision and a named beneficiary population exists. Operates at entry, before disbursement.

affected_population_verification_gate.x-cross-walkri-primitive: Affected Population Verification Gate (Evidence Strength configuration, Layer 4)
affected_population_verification_gate.x-cross-walkri-source-section: Primitives Foundation v0.2.0 Layer 4 (Evidence Strength configuration)
affected_population_verification_gate.description: Required when public_benefit_mechanism.mechanism_type is condition_change or access_provision. Operates at completion. Renamed from Beneficiary Accountability Gate at Primitives Foundation v0.1.7.

floor_categories.description: Disaggregation dimensions declared at entry that cannot be dropped at later gates (e.g., gender, race or ethnicity, geographic region, age cohort, disability status).

disaggregation_floor.description: Optional. Required when equity, inclusion, or population-targeted public benefit mechanisms are declared.

structural_separation_from_applicants.description: Statement of how the determination body is structurally separate from applicants and from program management.

charter_url.description: Stable URL of the publicly accessible charter or policy document specifying composition, scope, authority, and removal mechanism.

conflict_of_interest_procedure.description: How Tier 1 (categorical bar), Tier 2 (qualified waiver), and Tier 3 (disclosure encouraged) conflicts are handled.

determination_body.x-cross-walkri-source-section: CROSS Part VIII; Primitives Foundation v0.1.6 Layer 4
determination_body.description: The institutional layer that makes funding determinations, structurally separate from program management.

sources.description: Named third-party sources from which attestations about applicants are queryable (on-chain attestation registries, KarmaGAP, Gitcoin Explorer, deps.dev, GitHub archive, regulatory filings, etc.).

query_methodology.description: How the corpus is queried (typically against the On-chain Identity Anchor or legal entity identifier).

attestation_corpus_specification.description: The queryable record of contribution and use evidence this round operates against. Required per Commitment 6 Independent Verifiability.

publication_deadline.description: Publication deadline, which must precede the opening of the next cycle (pre-commitment as structural posture).

inter_cycle_reflection_stage.x-cross-walkri-primitive: Inter-cycle Reflection Stage (Program Learning Architecture configuration, Layer 7)
inter_cycle_reflection_stage.x-cross-walkri-source-section: Primitives Foundation v0.2.0 Layer 7 (Program Learning Architecture configuration)
inter_cycle_reflection_stage.description: Optional. Reflection on round outcomes published before the next cycle opens, instantiating pre-commitment as structural posture.

portfolio_level_continuation_benchmark.description: Optional. Funder-declared threshold that the program as a whole must meet to justify continued operation. Distinct from individual grantee continuation gates.

surfacing_obligation.description: Statement that applicants must surface adverse signals (prior rejections, contradictory findings, negative due diligence) and reviewers must not suppress signals found during evaluation.

adverse_signal_engagement_plan.x-cross-walkri-primitive: Adverse Signal Engagement Principle Core Standard
adverse_signal_engagement_plan.description: How adverse signals are surfaced and handled during the round. Required per the Adverse-Signal Engagement Principle Core Standard.

redress_provisions.description: Required. Redress and appeal procedures for completion-gate determinations. Part of the funder-side obligation architecture.

named_format_exceptions.description: Format requirements that are themselves primitive requirements (e.g., SPDX identifier for output_production access_condition; published URL for Attestation Corpus).

format_agnosticism_declaration.x-cross-walkri-source-section: Primitives Foundation v0.1.6 Layer 1; Evolution Rules v0.1.2 Commitment 5
format_agnosticism_declaration.description: Declares that this round accepts any infrastructure meeting the content requirements, regardless of format, except where format is itself a primitive requirement.

evidence_requirements.x-cross-walkri-source-section: WALKRI Sections 3 and 5; Primitives Foundation v0.1.6 Layers 4 and 5
evidence_requirements.description: Evidence form specifications and data quality standards applied across the round's gates.

non_disclosure_consequence.description: Per CROSS Part II Dimension 4: non-disclosure is a disqualifier; disclosure is not.

concurrent_funding_disclosure_requiremen.x-cross-walkri-source-section: CROSS Part II Dimension 4; Part I suite standard references
concurrent_funding_disclosure_requiremen.description: Concurrent funding disclosure requirements applied at entry gate.

conflict_of_interest_declaration_require.x-cross-walkri-source-section: CROSS Part VIII; Primitives Foundation v0.1.6 Layer 3
conflict_of_interest_declaration_require.description: Conflict of interest declaration and tier classification requirements.

coherence_disclosure_requirements.x-cross-walkri-source-section: CROSS Part III, IV; WALKRI applicant identity
coherence_disclosure_requirements.description: Internal consistency checks applied to applications.

application_period.x-cross-walkri-source-section: Primitives Foundation v0.1.6 Foundational Structural Anchors
application_period.description: The window during which applications are accepted. Operationalizes the List stage of CLEAR.

review_period.description: The window during which the determination body reviews applications. Operationalizes the Evaluate stage of CLEAR.

determination_publication_date.description: The date by which determinations are published into the institutional record. Operationalizes the Register stage of CLEAR.

reporting_cadence.description: Reporting cadence and format requirements for grantees.

lens_metadata.description: Lens Framework tagging for the round. Current-plus-target calibration tier per the Lenses Framework runbook output shape.

conforms_to.description: The schema version this instance claims to satisfy.

then.description: Population-anchored mechanism types require both entry-stage validation and completion-stage verification.

criterion_intent.description: Written statement of what the field measures, distinct from its label.

operational_definition.description: Complete definition of each option or response category with qualifying and non-qualifying examples.

response_form.description: Response type with written justification for why that type is appropriate for the criterion intent.

evidence_form.description: Specification of the artifact that satisfies the criterion: document type, data source, collection methodology at a level sufficient for independent replication.

conformance_threshold.description: For fields referencing an external standard: which components apply, what evidence satisfies each, and what the minimum threshold for passage is.

independent_verification_source.description: Named source outside the applicant's control from which verification can be obtained per Commitment 6.

evidence_form_specification.description: The five Criterion Specification Elements (Layer 5 primitive) plus independent verification source. Required for every measurement instrument in the round.
